description: Play Weiqi (Go) on 9×9, 13×13, or 19×19 against five local bot tiers, with undo, pass, resignation, and a Chinese-rules endgame count with dead-stone marking. Includes Capture Go, interactive lessons, kernel-verified tsumego with spaced repetition, SGF study and replay, and a glossary. The web client delegates legality, scoring, and records to @red-cup-engineering/weiqi-engine.
entryPointsNote: The current apps/weiqi-web/wrangler.jsonc and public-release contract name https://weiqi.561.group/ as the static-assets Cloudflare Worker receiver (no Durable Object binding or /api/matches server in that configuration). The separate wrangler.online.jsonc and Online Match code are unpublished, not a working public multiplayer feature. The alternate hostname weiqi.play.561.group is not established by this source configuration. npm run build / serve gives a local static preview.
seedPolicyNote: Weiqi engine moves and outcomes are deterministic for a supplied command log; local bot tie breaks take an injectable random source. The playable web app has no daily seed schedule. The separate online-match code is not shipped by the default static Worker configuration.
statusNote: As checked in the web app source on 2026-10-11: normal play supports 9×9, 13×13, and 19×19 as either color, five locally computed bot tiers, undo, pass, resign, engine-backed area counting and dead-group marking; Capture Go, Learn, Tsumego, Study/SGF, and Glossary are available as static pages. The current default Cloudflare configuration deploys those assets only; the separate Online Match Worker code is not in the shipped binding. A source configuration is not proof of live receiver health; confirm deployment independently. Further gaps include server-backed matches, ratings and a stronger GTP/KataGo opponent.
replayVerifierNote: The public module function accepts (config, entries, seed); it verifies the deterministic Weiqi command log using that explicit configuration.
